text:
Mina: Donut emergency  who wants me to pick up a half-dozen from Box & Crumb at 4pm? I can do mixed.
Omar: yes pls. glazed x1, maple x1. I'll Venmo.
Rae: throw in one vegan cinnamon if they have it. Also is there decaf? My afternoon jitters are real.
snack-bot: Fridge check: Decaf K-cups: 3, Whole milk: 1L, Oat milk: 0.5L, Donut stash: 0.
Mina: tally so far: glazed x1, maple x1, vegan cinnamon x1. Anyone else?
Ben: I can take a chocolate. I'll leave $3 in the tin.
Omar: sent $3.
Rae: I'll Venmo $3 to @mina. Also FYI the communal sugar jar is empty  could we pick one up?
Mina: will grab a small sugar pack and decaf pods if the shop stocks them. If not, I'll swing by the grocery.
snack-bot: Note: Please label any leftovers and avoid leaving boxes on the meeting room table.
Mina: pickup at 4:05, leaving on reception. Donuts will be boxed. ETA back around 4:25.
Ben: hero of the hour. :donut: Thanks!
Rae: thank you!! Also quick request  can we standardize where sugar lives? Counter vs shelf? Minor chaos otherwise.
Omar: agreed. Maybe shelf 3 next to tea.
Mina: agreed  sugar goes shelf 3. Post-run update: box arrived, all goodies on reception. Decaf pods were sold out but I left a note and bought a small sugar jar. Please take only one donut each so everyone gets one.
Ben: grabbed one. Perfect.
Rae: grabbed vegan cinnamon. label stickies work great. Thanks Mina!
